# KTEL template review copies

These are real empty templates generated by `app/domain/imports/templates.py`, provided for inspection alongside the working upload/review UI. Operational sheets have headings only; examples occur in Instructions. They do not import records by themselves.

- [Complete workbook — English](ktel-import-v1-complete-en.xlsx)
- [Complete workbook — Greek](ktel-import-v1-complete-el.xlsx)
- [Drivers CSV — English](ktel-import-v1-drivers-en.csv)
- [Drivers CSV — Greek](ktel-import-v1-drivers-el.csv)

The application generates downloads from the same source, with effective configured limits. These review copies are not a second source of truth. Regenerate them after template/schema changes. See [supported formats, limits and test evidence](../operations/SPREADSHEET_IMPORTS.md).
